title: Illustration in print and material
slide_intent: Compare an image language across surfaces because an expressive style should survive changes in texture and scale.
strategic_value: Line-drawn characters and patterned material can bring Dropbox’s illustration world into physical spaces.
demonstration: A paired photograph shows framed animal drawings above an orange sofa at left and layered colored patterned material at right.
practical_value: Compare line-led illustration with a dense material treatment.
